authority: Explanatory derivative following owner handoff V02; no new runtime contract, evidence anchor or domain execution.
intro: Research-informed scenarios. Source-bound execution evidence. Published operational challenges informed the scenario design. Radiolaria demonstrates selected software responses on controlled observations and mock effects; the cited researchers and institutions are not presented as project endorsers.
method: The chain is published problem → our software criterion → observed Sentinel behavior → exact execution source. R01–R12 establish external context; S and C identify recorded scenarios and contrasts; D01–D07 locate internal evidence. The translation into requirements is our engineering judgment, not a request attributed to the cited authors. Human direction, prepared AI assistants, Codex, domain adapters and the existing kernel all contributed. This is not automatic compilation of articles by BSEP. Specialists can inspect and challenge the mapping; a specialist-led revision cycle remains a future possibility, not an experiment already conducted.

matrix.published_challenge: Local hydrology and multiple observations matter to warning decisions.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Keep source purpose and dependencies; do not collapse the task to one rainfall value.
matrix.recorded_result: S1 / CURRENT_POLICY_E consumes changed monitoring configuration and cadence; C08 admits another evidence profile.
matrix.limit: Software dependency handling, not the authors’ hydrologic model or geological accuracy.

matrix.published_challenge: Storms, power loss and poor visibility can interrupt monitoring.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Distinguish capability failure, usable reserve and insufficient observations.
matrix.recorded_result: C03 records LIMITED after primary loss and INSUFFICIENT after reserve loss; S3 permits bounded local continuation.
matrix.limit: Controlled inputs; no reproduction of Bertorelle et al.’s virtual-sensor model.

matrix.published_challenge: Operator experience highlights robust monitoring and redundancy.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Check provenance and independence, not just the presence of a second message.
matrix.recorded_result: C04 rejects duplicate, misordered or shared-upstream evidence as independent confirmation.
matrix.limit: Declared lineage checks cannot independently establish physical truth.

matrix.published_challenge: Debris-flow vibrations must be distinguished from other signals.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Use ambiguity to select a bounded additional investigation.
matrix.recorded_result: S2/C01’s latest live pair changes only the source-bound note; actual Work checks metadata or reads and processes reserve history.
matrix.limit: Meaning affects executed work; no seismic ML detector or claimed superiority.

matrix.published_challenge: Post-fire debris flows may leave inadequate warning time after local detection.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Avoid mandatory dependence on optional cloud reasoning once local action is authorized.
matrix.recorded_result: C06/S3 performs fresh local Work through the same Root/Host and mock ON while the controlled provider worker remains pending.
matrix.limit: Our timeliness criterion; no forecast lead-time result or field deadline.

matrix.published_challenge: A measurement interval and its telemetry delivery frequency differ.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Separate observed and received time; check interval, statistic, units and purpose.
matrix.recorded_result: C02 rejects fresh arrival as proof of freshness; later checks require supported hourly intervals. Real EA capture preserves unknown endpoints.
matrix.limit: HTTP success establishes neither current slope evidence nor a verified gauge-to-site mapping.

matrix.published_challenge: Open review asks for clarity about temporal resolution and operator-dependent interpretation.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Retain source-bound notes, versions, windows and inputs actually used.
matrix.recorded_result: C01/C02/C04/C10 retain the evidence and conditions behind investigation, applicability and policy decisions.
matrix.limit: Process inspectability; no inter-operator study, ROC/AUC evaluation or judgment that final article errors remain.

matrix.published_challenge: Delayed soil-moisture products can remain useful as prior context.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Distinguish historical usefulness from eligibility for a current action.
matrix.recorded_result: C02 preserves context-only data; C10/LocalDRS makes stale policy or calibration dependencies ineligible for current reuse.
matrix.limit: Conditional memory reuse; the authors’ ERA5-Land model was not executed.

matrix.published_challenge: Multiple surges complicate the duration of an alarm.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Require positive recovery evidence; quiet, missing messages and expiry alone cannot clear an incident.
matrix.recorded_result: C07/S5 uses a fresh measured sequence and a separate native OFF; repeated frames and cleanup do not establish recovery.
matrix.limit: Synthetic recovery rules; operational thresholds still require domain expertise.

matrix.published_challenge: Observation, warning dissemination and human response are distinct; alert messages have a lifecycle.
matrix.our_software_criterion: Separate incident state, signal, outbox delivery and acknowledgement.
matrix.recorded_result: S4/C09 retains an immutable report, fresh delivery, matching identity/hash and UNKNOWN after missing acknowledgement, without repeating ON.
matrix.limit: Local mock receiver; CAP-inspired clarity, not CAP conformance, mass warning or demonstrated evacuation.

owner_reported_time: Approximately 12 hours of Sentinel implementation on the existing kernel — owner-reported elapsed time. The owner’s estimate covers implementation and checks reaching accepted commit/push. Earlier kernel/domain development is excluded; the complete duration and cost of prior research and specification are not established. Presentation preparation followed implementation and was interrupted by tool limits. This is neither an independently timed benchmark nor a comparison against another stack, a model-call duration, an alarm-response measurement or total research-and-development time.
whitepaper_paragraph: Landslide Sentinel demonstrates a path from published domain challenges to executable software criteria. Reports of monitoring failures, delayed telemetry and multi-surge alarm handling informed selected requirements and counterexamples. Built on the existing Radiolaria kernel, the demonstration connects these responses to local decisions, actual result consumption and inspectable execution records. Its value is a rapidly constructed, traceable prototype: published context, explicit requirement, implementation and recorded evidence remain distinguishable and linked. The owner reports approximately 12 hours for Sentinel implementation on the established foundation; this is not total research-and-development time or a comparative benchmark. The case supports a practical direction for testing software responses to domain requirements, not a claim of completed geophysical validation, field readiness or measured scaling performance.
evidence_scope: S0–S5 and C01–C10 span controlled, live and later correction lanes. They are not a newly executed aggregate test suite. Earlier inconclusive C01 pairs remain history beside the later valid live pair. The real cloud provider’s provenance remains visible; a physical local SLM was not installed. A model-free local branch is distinct from cloud emulation of a local analyst role. The independent safe-derived pin covers only enumerated LS2R2 package fields, not this research insert, the whole history or physical truth. No domain, provider, sensor or D/E execution was performed for this update.
attribution_and_limits: Research references identify published context, not collaboration or endorsement. The scenario mapping and software implementation are Radiolaria’s own. Scientific performance reported by cited authors is not attributed to this demonstration. All external descriptions are short original paraphrases with bibliographic attribution; no third-party figures, photographs, logos or long quotations are reproduced. The source collection spans different years and countries and establishes no causal narrative about a particular Nepal disaster. No scientists’ participation in the project is implied.
